text_block_list.text:
It seemed you could watch what was 
happening inside the simulator via 
monitors, and a crowd of spectators had 
gathered.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Long-awaited! This day has finally 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Governing vast amounts of data, it is no 
exaggeration to say the Three Goddesses 
know everything there is to know about 
Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A thrilling race of champions chosen by 
those very fans! Please! Deliver your 
passion and excitement to the world!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I believe this race will serve as the 
ultimate culmination to test everything 
the two of you have achieved so far.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good luck to both of you, <chrname>-san and Trainer 
<username>-san!

Sent off by a large crowd of onlookers, I 
headed into the VR simulator world 
alongside <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the WBC, little lamb.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're aiming for the peak of a 
towering mountain—are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we've worked so hard to make it this 
far, after all.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Let's see it then— the running you've 
built up together to get this far.
And so, the WBC finally begins!
